findings.title: A replay of a dispatch that already committed now returns xometry_beta_job_busy, and the new client copy wrongly says "Nothing was queued" and clears the recovery state
findings.evidence:
In supabase/migrations/20261004100000_ovd598_serialize_legacy_xometry_admission.sql the NOWAIT helper is called at :122, before the replay/permit lookup at :124-127 and before the deduplicated return at :148-165. So a replay with the original approval reference fails busy whenever any scope row is held, even though the permit already exists.

Scratch probe (a copy of the suite with an extra block, run at c5adabe under /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock, then deleted and never committed), on fixture job 17:
- REPLAY 1 first: created=true, permitId bfc3d698...
- REPLAY 2 replay_idle: deduplicated=true, same permitId
- REPLAY 3: a worker session opens a transaction with api_register_trusted_file_hash on the CAD file
- REPLAY 4 replay_while_worker_open: {"error": "xometry_beta_job_busy", "sqlstate": "P0001"}
- REPLAY 5 replay_after_worker_commit: deduplicated=true, same permitId
- permits for job 17: 1

Before this PR (base ac5026fe) the replay took no row locks and always returned the dedup result.

On the client side:
- the uncertain-outcome recovery ("Check previous quote request", src/pages/ClientPart.tsx:570-582) re-sends the original approvalReference (XometryBetaDispatchConfirmationDialog.tsx:359);
- busy is classified as an explicit denial (xometry-beta-dispatch.ts:281-286);
- use-client-part-controller.ts:1557-1561 then sets attemptedQuoteRef to null and clears uncertainQuoteIdentity, so canRecoverQuoteRequest becomes false (:1650-1655);
- :699-706 toasts the new copy from xometry-beta-dispatch.ts:289-293: "Nothing was queued: this part is being updated in another session. Request the quote again in a moment."

That statement is false for a replay whose original committed. A fresh request then yields xometry_beta_new_lane_required (impl dedup), so the user is told twice that nothing was queued while a dispatch is in flight. Real writers that open this window include client part/requirement edits, the worker's jobs status update (worker/src/index.ts:413-418), a cancel's `update public.jobs`, and extraction-time trusted-hash staging.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the client mapping, which is already in scope. Reword the busy copy so it does not claim nothing was queued, for example "This part is being updated in another session. Try again in a moment." Also, when the failing call is an exact uncertain replay (same approvalReference), keep the attempt in status "unknown" on xometry_beta_job_busy, so the "Check previous quote request" recovery stays available. Add a ClientPart/controller test for busy on replay. A server-side alternative is to do the permit lookup before the helper and return the dedup result directly. That changes the order of the replay lookup, so it needs coordinator sign-off.
